commands.name: ApplyAcceptedRfcSourceProjection
commands.visibility: internal cross-packet command invoked by LLD-04 accepted reconciliation; not a raw workbook route
input: accepted LLD-04 RFC reconciliation proposal with exact RFC/base/evidence/review bindings
parent command_context carrying outer command_id/hash and already-inserted parent command_receipt
steps: inside the shared UoW require the LLD-04 parent command receipt already exists, then load exact RFC/current projection/hierarchy and revalidate current owner state
validate accepted evidence identities and LLD-04 precedence through RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
determine the exact current-field changes and any terminal-epoch/cascade effect
apply only accepted usable current field changes using the parent command context for provenance; LLD-03 inserts no command receipt
for transition into terminal allocate terminal_epoch_id and atomically capture/insert exact pending cascade proposal and immutable RFC/WFM membership
for terminal reversal require exact fresh high-risk review, clear current terminal epoch and supersede any still-pending proposal for that epoch without undoing executed history
append minimal LLD-03 audit/result references and return RfcLifecycleProjectionV1 to the LLD-04 coordinator without nested commit
rules: LLD-04 AcceptReconciliationProposal exclusively owns replay resolution, command_id/hash authority, the single command receipt and the outer commit for this shared UnitOfWork
source acceptance never overwrites RFC hierarchy, SR links, Device Reference links, Working Notes, archive state or canonical Customer without their governed commands
terminal evidence acceptance never executes Task/Objective/Communication cascade consequences
unchanged current accepted fields produce semantic NO_CHANGE at field level and no duplicate current-history authority

commands.name: RefreshRfcTerminalCascadeProposal
commands.response: RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 exact persisted state produced inside the owning writer UnitOfWork; NO_CHANGE returns unchanged pending state, material refresh returns replacement pending state
steps: inside UoW prove proposal is pending at exact base revision and trigger RFC still has same terminal_epoch_id
load current accepted terminal status class/evidence for that epoch; Closed<->Cancelled correction becomes replacement terminal binding, while nonterminal/reversed or different epoch is stale
capture current exact RFC/WFM scope using current accepted terminal class/evidence and compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 replacement fingerprint
if terminal class/evidence and complete scope fingerprint are unchanged return semantic NO_CHANGE with exact unchanged state
insert receipt, supersede old proposal, insert replacement pending proposal/member rows using same terminal epoch/current binding, audit refresh, persist exact replacement state, commit
rules: refresh never executes downstream consequences
executed or superseded proposal cannot be refreshed
refresh never edits proposal identity/evidence/fingerprint/member rows in place
terminal evidence correction within same epoch is a material refresh even when membership unchanged
refresh never invokes PreviewRfcTerminalCascade inside writer UnitOfWork

commands.name: ArchiveRfc
steps: exact replay resolves before owner preparation/current-state reads
inside UoW recompute complete current SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 and require reviewed_scope_fingerprint exact match; client supplies no member revision list
identify active members and already-archived excluded members
if no active member return semantic NO_CHANGE ArchiveRfcResultV1 with null operation id and no operation/event/audit
allocate archive operation ID; after Foundation receipt insertion create operation row
transition each active reviewed member to archived, increment revision once, insert immutable operation membership and archived event
audit scalar counts/fingerprint with exactly one result ref to the archive operation; never copy member IDs into audit JSON/result refs
persist exact fixed-size ArchiveRfcResultV1 and commit
rules: archive affects RFC local presentation only
pre-existing archived members are never claimed by this operation
reviewed_branch requires explicit complete preview and requested RFC remains parentless at writer revalidation
request/audit/replay bounds never impose branch-member business cap

commands.name: RestoreRfcArchiveOperation
commands.response: RfcArchiveOperationV1 exact bounded operation projection with complete SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_OPERATION_PROJECTION_V1; command response first page contains at most 32 RfcArchiveOperationMemberV1 items and continuation binds that exact projection fingerprint
steps: exact replay resolves before current-state reads
inside UoW load immutable operation membership and latest event per member
select only members still archived by this exact origin operation; later restored/rearchived members are skipped
if no member eligible compute the complete current operation projection fingerprint and return semantic NO_CHANGE with exact bounded RfcArchiveOperationV1 first page of at most 32 members
after Foundation receipt insertion transition every eligible member active/increment revision and append restored events; mutation cardinality is independent of response-page cardinality
audit scalar changed_rfc_count with exactly one result ref to origin archive operation; exact restored identities stay row-wise events

after all mutations recompute/derive the complete current operation member projection, compute SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_OPERATION_PROJECTION_V1, build at most 32 first-page members plus continuation bound to that fingerprint, persist exact response and commit
rules: restore never activates a member this operation did not itself archive
source lifecycle/status and downstream domains remain untouched
audit/result-ref/replay-response bounds never impose operation-member business cap
RfcArchiveOperationMemberV1 is the exact member projection type; command response paging is presentation only and does not bound restore work

replayed command response is immutable historical evidence; following its continuation after any later operation-member projection change fails stale/invalid rather than combining historical first-page state with newer continuation rows

commands.name: HardDeleteRfc
commands.response: HardDeleteRfcResultV1 fixed-size exact committed deletion evidence; exact same-command replay returns the stored result before proof/provider/current-RFC reads
steps: resolve exact LLD-01 replay before owner preparation; deliberate proof bearer is excluded from the semantic request hash while rfc_id, base_revision and eligibility_fingerprint remain semantic authority
inside one short writer UnitOfWork load exact RFC identity/rfc_no/revision and require current revision equals base_revision

rerun all eleven local hard-delete guards plus LLD-04/05/07/09 read-only dependency classifiers against the current UnitOfWork read context; derive exact provider classification tokens and recompute SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_ELIGIBILITY_V1
if any local/provider blocker or INDETERMINATE exists return RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED before proof consumption and with no receipt/audit/delete
if current eligibility_fingerprint differs from the reviewed fingerprint return RFC_HARD_DELETE_PREVIEW_STALE before proof consumption

only then call LLD-12 validate_and_consume for action tickets.rfc.hard_delete, DeliberateActionTargetV1{target_type:rfc,target_id:rfc_id}, exact base_revision and preview_fingerprint=eligibility_fingerprint; invalid/expired/session-mismatched/wrong-bound/already-consumed proof returns RFC_HARD_DELETE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED without domain mutation
allocate one hard-delete audit_event_id and use that same UUID as hard_delete_evidence_id
insert one command receipt, append ticket.rfc.hard_deleted while rfc_id/rfc_no still exist with exactly one hard_delete_evidence result ref pointing to audit_event_id, then DELETE only the RFC row
persist exact HardDeleteRfcResultV1 containing outcome=deleted, deleted rfc_id/rfc_no, reviewed_revision, eligibility_fingerprint and hard_delete_evidence_id; commit atomically

if unexpected FK/constraint/audit/result persistence fails after proof consumption, roll back receipt/audit/delete/result; RFC remains intact but the consumed proof remains unusable and a retry requires a fresh deliberate action
rules: only a provably untouched manual or purely local provisional draft is eligible
accepted source adoption/provenance, hierarchy/SR/Device/Note/WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory/archive/correction/terminal-cascade history blocks deletion
creation audit alone does not make a never-used local draft undeletable; post-creation protected activity does
no default local child rows are silently deleted to manufacture eligibility
ordinary history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows
LLD-03 never persists proof/challenge/session material
same command_id replay after successful deletion reconstructs nothing from deleted current state and consumes no second proof
